text: Implemented explicit immutable world-coordinate snapshot with balanced nearest-vertex indexing, deterministic original-id ties, finite-coordinate validation and full affine world metric. Mutable meshes require explicit reprepare; no implicit owner-key cache. Shared independent landmark/brute-force, scale/shear/rotation, boundary, mutation/replacement and malformed-input tests. surfaceViewJVM/test and surfaceViewJS/test each 54 passed. Primitive-scan benchmark at synthetic 10,449/163,842 vertices: 1000 queries 8.83/220.09ms scan vs 2.74/17.23ms indexed; builds 9.09/48.84ms, crossover1495/241 queries. Retained292572/4587576 bytes; ~112B/query. README records exact limitations and runnable harness. Log /private/tmp/next-five-world-index-final.log.
